en-GB.name: Recharge Workout Recovery Time
en-GB.subtitle: Countdown for your Apple Watch
en-GB.promotional_text: Garmin-style recovery time on the Apple Watch already on your wrist. A countdown after every hard session, a clear Ready when it runs out, four complications.
en-GB.release_notes:
First release.

• Recovery countdown after every qualifying workout, with a clear Ready mark
• Apple Watch app and four complication families: circular, rectangular, inline, and corner
• Separate recovery curves for endurance, strength, mixed (HYROX / CrossFit), and easy sessions
• One-tap effort rating on the wrist for sessions where wrist heart rate isn't reliable
• Full explanation of every estimate: which session set it, how hard it was for you, and how confident it is
en-GB.price_disclosure: Prices are shown in the app before you buy and vary by region

en-GB.description:
Finish a hard session and Recharge starts a countdown. When it runs out, you get a clear Ready.

That is the whole app. It is the answer a Garmin gives you after an activity, built for the Apple Watch already on your wrist. No ring, no chest strap, no second hardware ecosystem to subscribe to.

WHAT YOU SEE

• A countdown in hours after every qualifying workout
• A clear Ready mark when the estimate expires
• The reason behind it: which session set the window, and how confident Recharge is
• Watch complications in four families — circular, rectangular, inline, and corner — in the style you choose

BUILT FOR HYBRID TRAINING

Recharge runs a separate curve for each kind of session, because an hour under a barbell and an hour on the bike do not cost the same thing:

• Endurance: run, ride, row, swim. Heart-rate-reserve load from your workout heart rate.
• Strength: lifting. Wrist heart rate is unreliable under grip and bar contact, so Recharge asks you one question instead of guessing.
• Mixed: HYROX, CrossFit, circuits. Both systems taxed, so the longest window.
• Easy: walks, yoga, mobility. Counted as active recovery. Never starts or extends a countdown.

HONEST BY DESIGN

Recharge shows you a bounded window, not a false-precision number. It shows which signal produced the estimate, and how confident it is.

STANDARD, FREE

The standard estimate is one shared table, set to your training level: session type, length, and intensity, scored against the heart-rate range for your age.

• Apple Health workout import
• The countdown and the Ready state
• Apple Watch app
• All four complication families
• iPhone explanation of your latest estimate

RECHARGE+

Recharge+ replaces that table with you: every session is scored against your own 42-day baseline, and the last 30 days set how fast your countdowns run.

• A recovery time built from your own history, not a population average
• Sleep, resting heart rate, and HRV folded into each estimate
• Calibration from how you say you actually felt when a countdown ran out
• Weekly load against your own four-week average
• Per-session workout-type override
• Optional notification the moment you are Ready

Recharge+ is available as a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

• Monthly and yearly subscriptions include a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers
• Lifetime is a one-time purchase with no subscription or renewal

{price_disclosure}. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically, and your account is charged within 24 hours before the end of the current period, unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before it ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Privacy Policy: https://jackwallner.github.io/recovery/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

PRIVACY

Recharge reads from Apple Health and writes nothing back. Your data stays on your devices. There is no account and no sign-in. Purchases go through Apple and RevenueCat.

IMPORTANT

Recharge gives a cardiovascular training estimate based on your recent workout load. It is not medical advice and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition, and it cannot tell you whether you are physically fit to train. Cardiovascular load, muscle soreness, connective tissue, illness, and mental fatigue are not the same thing. Always use your own judgement, and speak to a qualified professional about your health.

Recharge is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Garmin, WHOOP, Oura, Polar, Coros, HYROX, CrossFit, or Apple. Product names are trademarks of their respective owners.

Requires iOS 17 or later. An Apple Watch that records your workouts is strongly recommended.
